item.title: Why Was Nancy Guthrie Taken?
item.description: Authorities believe Nancy Guthrie was kidnapped, abducted or otherwise taken against her will.

item.title: Kouri Richins Spoke to ME Several Times About Eric’s Medical History
item.description: Dr. Pamela Sue Ulmer said autopsy results reveal Eric Richins had toxic levels of fentanyl and its metabolites in his system, when she would expect to find no presence of the drug because he had no history of illicit or prescription drug abuse.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie: Did Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos Botch Investigation?
item.description: As the search for Nancy Guthrie continues, questions are being raised whether this investigation was botched from the beginning, with some blaming Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos for how the investigation has been handled from the outset. (2/26/26)

item.title: UT v. Kouri Richins: Key Moments from Day 3
item.description: On day three, lead evidence technician, Chelsea Gipson described finding gummies, pill bottles but no drug paraphernalia at the Richins' home. Kouri Richins is accused of poisoning her husband with a lethal dose of fentanyl. (2/25/26)

item.title: Colin Gray’s Police Interview After Son Allegedly Shot Up School
item.description: The jury listens to audio from a Georgia Bureau of Investigations interview with defendant Colin Gray after his son, Colt Gray, allegedly killed two students and two teachers at Apalachee High School in Sept. 2024. (2/25/26)

item.title: Photo Shows Colt Gray With Gun Barrel In His Mouth
item.description: A digital forensic examiner testified to multiple photos found on Colt Gray's phone, as well as searches his father did for boarding schools. Colt's father, Colin Gray, is standing trial for the murders of four people at Apalachee High School. (2/26/26)

item.description: VERO BEACH, Fla. (Court TV) — A former police officer was arrested on charges that he tried to flee from police after he was named as a person of interest in his parents’ murders. item.title: Accused killer found competent to stand trial after removing his own eyeballs
item.description: STATESBORO, Ga. (Court TV) — A Georgia judge has found a man competent to stand trial on murder charges despite the fact that the defendant removed his own eyes. item.title: Former Family Housekeeper Says She Sold Fentanyl to Kouri Richins
item.description: Carmen Lauber, the former housekeeper for the Richins family told investigators she sold fentanyl to defendant Kouri Richins, who is accused of poisoning her husband, Eric Richins with a lethal dose of fentanyl and then writing a children's book on grief. (2/26/26)
